conclusion: ChronoReplay replays heterogeneous spatial supervision in source chronology, retains native targets, and improves OVO-S, OST, and UCS together under matched observation access. We call the uneven cross-readout transfer observed in single-family training interface lock-in , an empirical pattern rather than an isolated internal mechanism. The single-family comparison retains the tradeoff: categorical-only training favors OVO-S, trajectory-only training gives little OST Overall gain, and full ChronoReplay has the highest three-benchmark mean. Objective controls show further gains beyond ordinary joint SFT. The full recipe gains 13.41 OST points over the base; the paired cyclic-shift control isolates a smaller, repeatable 2.41-point contribution from preserving source chronology as a whole.
